# Mungale Eye Hospital

> Specialist eye hospital in Kothi, Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Founded 2007.
> Led by ophthalmologists Dr. Sachin Mungale (MS — Ophthalmology,
> Glaucoma Fellowship, LVPEI) and Dr. Meeta Mungale (MS — Ophthalmology,
> DNB, Cornea Fellowship, LVPEI). Referral centre for cornea and glaucoma
> care.

## Contact

## Doctors

- [Dr. Sachin Mungale](https://mungaleeyehospital.com/doctors/sachin-mungale/): Ophthalmic Surgeon · Glaucoma Specialist. MS (Ophthalmology) · Glaucoma Fellowship, LVPEI. Gujarat Medical Council Reg. No. G-12281. 19+ years; heads the hospital's glaucoma department since 2007.
- [Dr. Meeta Mungale](https://mungaleeyehospital.com/doctors/meeta-mungale/): Ophthalmic Surgeon · Cornea Specialist. MS (Ophthalmology), DNB · Cornea Fellowship, LVPEI. Gujarat Medical Council Reg. No. G-39262. 19+ years; more than 500 corneal transplants.
- All medical content on this site is reviewed by the doctors. The reviewer of each page is listed in llms-full.txt.

## Services

- Cataract Surgery (phacoemulsification, lens implants)
- Cornea Evaluation and Corneal Treatments (infections, injuries, transplants)
- Glaucoma Evaluation and Glaucoma Treatments (drops, laser, surgery)
- Optical & Contact Lenses
